description: This file defines a custom exception class ReportMailingJobRunHistoryNotFoundException, which extends AbstractPlatformResourceNotFoundException. It is used to indicate that a report mailing job run history resource was not found, by including a specific message and a reportMailingJobId parameter.

classes.name: ReportMailingJobRunHistoryNotFoundException
classes.description: A runtime exception indicating that a report mailing job run history resource was not found.

methods.name: ReportMailingJobRunHistoryNotFoundException
methods.description: Constructor that creates a new exception instance with a message indicating the report mailing job run history with the specified ID does not exist.
